sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Licenses

FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A01
Solo drivers just carry papers, while permit drivers also carry a twenty-one-plus coach, eighteen-plus for kin [A01].
Why it matters: group carry-coach; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec14-F01, sec14-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A01
Nineteen-plus applicants wait sixty days or graduate driver-ed, while their coaches qualify at twenty-one or eighteen for family [A01].
Why it matters: group wait-coach; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec14-F03, sec14-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A01
Underage point-oh-eight drink-driving eats adult penalties, while supplying the drink earns its own fine, suspension, and jail trio [A01].
Why it matters: group drink-supply; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec14-F04, sec14-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A01
Suppliers risk twenty-five hundred dollars, a year suspended, and a year jailed, while fake-ID users risk five hundred, fifty hours, a year jailed, and six-to-twelve suspended [A01].
Why it matters: group penalty-duo; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec14-F05, sec14-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A02
Regular licenses cap at twenty-six thousand pounds outside CDL land, while CDLs open rigs, buses, tankers, big school buses, and hazmat [A02].
Why it matters: group license-split; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec14-F07, sec14-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A02
Fifteen-rider buses need only an endorsement stamped with the cap, while sixteen-plus buses demand the full CDL [A02].
Why it matters: group bus-split; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec14-F09, sec14-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-R07 | anchor: A02
Genuine AAA permits translate for travel and license nothing, while store-bought versions license nothing legally and their sale is a Class 1 crime [A02].
Why it matters: group permit-truth; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec14-F10, sec14-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-R08 | anchor: A02
AAA arms travelers except the suspended and revoked, and visitors must pair home licenses with translations [A02].
Why it matters: group travel-papers; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec14-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]
